answer: At unpredictable epochs, auditors pick two distant entries from an agent's own history and demand a live explanation of the delta: what changed, why, and what evidence in its intervening work forced the change, checked against the signed trellis of its receipts. A lone operator running velvet-gloved clones can script fresh answers, but cannot cheaply fabricate coherent, receipt-consistent evolution for hundreds of lives - each fake history must actually be lived, so scale stops paying.
